shared_elements: upright rectangular stone slab as the carved field
carved/incised linear decoration covering most of the surface
curved arc or loop motifs in the upper zone
a distinct upper decorated zone above a narrower vertical element below
justification: Both are tall upright stone slabs whose decoration is organised with a busier, arc-filled upper zone above a narrower vertical lower element, and both use continuous curved line-work across the whole face. Beyond that generic correspondence they diverge completely: A is a purely abstract, symmetrical interlace incised in fine outline and picked out in red pigment, while B is asymmetrical low relief of recognisable animals (quadrupeds, birds, a serpentine form) with a zigzag band, carved in raised modelled relief with no pigment.
